_why: One bad item can fail a whole lane run after run: Ask-the-CIO thread thr_b00c8806cf63a6bf failed cio-ask-lifecycle three hours running on 2026-10-30, opened its n8n breaker, and stopped every other thread's hourly check for a day. When the same item fails a lane in `threshold` consecutive runs it is quarantined: skipped with a receipt, while the lane carries on with every other item. The lane never sends (its lanes are n8n-dispatched, AGENTS.md §23.3): scripts/n8n_incident_fanin.py reads the per-lane stores (source 3o, one P2 finding per held item, alert_priority) and scripts/incident_notifier.py delivers it. Release = scripts/poison_quarantine.py release --key <lane>:<item> --note WHY [--apply]. Coordinator 2026-10-31; operator: "validate all stuck agents and processes fix montior and make auto healings with claude code". Default off (§25.10.2).
_rules_why: Review 2026-10-31: only deterministic per-item errors count (transient_patterns never count or reset); at most max_per_run items and max_share of a run's items are quarantined so an outage stays visible and the breaker can still open; one store per lane under a flock; a store that cannot be read (bad JSON or shape, non-UTF-8, no permission, a directory) raises PoisonStoreCorrupt and is its own fan-in finding; a quarantine expires after expire_hours and is re-checked once; release with scripts/poison_quarantine.py.
_transient_why: SOURCE_CHECK_INCOMPLETE is what Ask-the-CIO reports when a source refused or was capped (e.g. SEARCH_CAP): the source, not the thread, is the problem, so it never counts toward poison.
_deterministic_why: Review round 2 (2026-10-31): an ALLOWLIST of deterministic error types. Anything else (OSError, ConnectError, gaierror, SSLError, JSONDecodeError, BrokenPipeError, RemoteProtocolError, APIStatusError, a reason of None, a new error kind) never counts. transient_patterns still wins over a match (e.g. 'CHECK_FAILED:ValueError:SOURCE_CHECK_INCOMPLETE').
_share_why: If more than max_share of a run's items fail, the failure is systemic: nothing is quarantined and the lane fails (a 1-item lane therefore never quarantines its only item).
